tools.name: stamp_hash
tools.description: Returns a signed receipt {sha256, stamped_at, key_id, signature, public_key_url}: a booklint-family service saw this hash at stamped_at, signed with key key_id. tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Checks a receipt from stamp_hash against the published public keys (same check as POST /v1/verify; pass the receipt fields as arguments). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_receipt · Private data: stamp_hash · Public sink: stamp_hash, verify_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_receipt · Private data: stamp_hash · Public sink: stamp_hash, verify_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
